file_change.purpose: Load, validate, and mechanically assess executable Plan artifacts.
implementation: Load plan.schema.json as the schema for the root manifest only; treat plan.json as a manifest rather than as the container of all Plan semantics.
Resolve the manifest documents object and load exactly the referenced requirements, file-plan, execution, invariants, validation, and completion subdocuments.
Validate each Plan subdocument against its dedicated accepted schema and require artifact_type, schema_version, and plan_id to match the logical Plan contract.

Canonicalize every referenced Plan-document path relative to the functional-set directory; reject absolute paths, traversal, duplicate references, and references outside the authorized Plan directory.
Enumerate Plan JSON documents in the functional-set directory excluding functional-set.json and reject any Plan document not explicitly reachable from the root manifest.
Resolve the referenced functional-set artifact and require matching functional_set.id and exact Design revision bindings.

Require implementation_predecessor.repository_revision to equal the functional-set accepted predecessor while allowing only explicitly governed bootstrap Planning-artifact descendants in the working repository state.
Validate normative requirement uniqueness, normative-statement contract compliance, and applicability records through normative.py.

Perform executability preflight against repository.py: reject duplicate/conflicting target operations, unresolved dependencies, path traversal, impossible delete/modify assumptions, and unauthorized mutation paths.
Construct and return one frozen logical Plan model containing the resolved authorized graph; Build consumes that model and never rewrites Plan intent.
